scope: Frontend-only explicit section client and account-scoped admin cache; no backend, Rules, indexes or new Functions.
behavior: Bootstrap only missing sections; retain completed sections across tabs and share pending section requests in StrictMode and rapid navigation.
Reject missing explicit protocol/requested properties; do not fall back to the full legacy admin reader.
Fence per-section responses and common seeded metadata across successful mutations; reconcile outstanding dirty sections without reusing pre-commit reads.
Order patches recalculate loaded-order totals and invalidate stock. Inactive stock waits until consumed; refreshing cached stock keeps the current view mounted.

Account/role/demo changes remount private state. Denied reads clear all cached sections and fence other in-flight responses. Transient errors require explicit retry and preserve mounted forms when cached data exists.
Show totals only for sections used by the active tab and warn when a source cap is reached. No periodic refresh is introduced.

broadRun.note: Three new timing assertions observed the DOM before a queued React render; assertions now await the committed state.

finalAffectedRuns.scope: Actual operations draft retained after a failed refresh

readBudget.menuColdStart: One scoped call: meals/config; no orders, inventory, refunds or deliveries.
readBudget.menuThenInventory: Second call requests inventory only; cached meals/config reused.
readBudget.ordersThenInventoryThenMenuThenOperation: Two calls: orders/config, then meals/inventory. Remaining tabs reuse cache.
readBudget.idle: One-hour menu/dispatch fixtures issue no additional periodic business calls.

tradeoffs: Visiting every tab can add authentication/configuration reads compared with one broad bootstrap; gains depend on which tabs are actually used.
Source document limits and returned-row budgets are not Enterprise billed units or a measured currency reduction.
Other-device catalog edits appear on manual refresh or a new workspace; this adds no catalog realtime fanout.

rollout.requires: Finish the coordinated Academy release and integrate its main/Rules, then deploy and verify PR31 listEatCleanAdminData before merging this UI.
rollout.rollback: Restore the previous frontend; the optional-section reader remains compatible with omitted sections.
